text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Lightning Dash, here I come~~!!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Tama seems to be having fun lately. She's 
just bursting with energy.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: We can't afford to lose either~.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Well look at that, both of you came to 
watch!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪ Tama-chan ran wonderfully today, 
didn't she~?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Running must have made you hungry, right? 
Once you change, shall we go grab an 
Everest-sized bowl of tonkotsu shoyu 
ramen?"

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"As a reward for your hard work, our 
treat's on us♪ And plenty of headpats, 
too~."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"There's no way I can finish an 
Everest-sized portion! And quit patting my 
head, too!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
—Still, well, there's no denying I'm on a 
roll right now!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ever since teaming up with my Trainer, my 
body feels lighter, or rather, my running 
and my retorts have gotten a whole lot 
sharper!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Wait, training and snappy comebacks have 
nothin' to do with each other, though!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu. Tama-chan is stepping up nicely, 
isn't she~?"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Then, to step it up, another Mt. 
Everest-sized bowl...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My headpats are gonna step up a notch 
too~♪

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Gaaahhh! I don't need that one~~~!!
